chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad and Abū Dāwūd, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: “The woman in postnatal bleeding refrains for the number of days of her menstruation during which she used to menstruate, then she takes an additional precautionary period, performs ghusl, and offers salat (prayer).”

key_terms.أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا: the days of her usual menstrual period
key_terms.النُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she takes an additional precautionary waiting period

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a woman in nifās regarding how long she leaves salat and when she performs ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the woman experiencing nifās (postnatal bleeding). It states that she refrains from salat for the number of days corresponding to her usual menstrual period, then after an additional precautionary period she performs ghusl and resumes salat (prayer).
